basics.name: Claiderman Alexander Lozano Cardona
basics.label: Backend Developer with Microservices and Cloud Experience
basics.summary: Backend Developer with over 4 years of experience in software development. Proficient in Java, TypeScript, Python, and cloud services (AWS, Azure). Has worked implementing REST APIs, managing databases, and deploying cloud solutions. Has contributed to projects for clients like Bancolombia, Banistmo, and Grupo Familia, and currently works on backend development for video games and interactive applications at Polygonus. Enjoys continuous learning and adapting to new technologies.

Develops APIs with Python (Django/FastAPI) for educational platforms
